summary: Six recorded mission events replayed with the production engine and recorded in app/public/data/validation.json (row mission-hindcasts). Tolerances were fixed on 2026-11-15, before the first run; a missed tolerance would remain in the results with its explanation. All six sub-checks pass.

subChecks.reference: NASA catalogue greatest eclipse 2025-03-14T06:58:47Z, limit 5 min
Firefly imagery: Sun hidden about 07:30 UTC, Sun back about 08:30 UTC
subChecks.measured: fraction 0.0000 at 07:30 UTC; Sun back 2025-03-14 08:36:52.5 UTC (allowed 08:10-08:50 UTC)

subChecks.reference: Last contact 2025-03-16 23:25 UTC, about 5 h after sunset; tool sunset within 3 h of 18:25 UTC, grade D
ISRO: Pragyan parked 2023-09-02, Vikram 2023-09-04; tool sunset must fall after the 2023-09-04 sleep reference; tolerance fixed before running
subChecks.measured: first sunset 2023-09-04 07:26:52.5 UTC, 0.31 days after the sleep reference (grade C, LOLA 240 m skyline)

subChecks.reference: SLIM landed 2024-01-19 15:20 UTC with cells facing west; power returned 2024-01-28
subChecks.measured: Sun azimuth 81.7 deg at landing (east), 276.7 deg on 2024-01-28 (west)

subChecks.reference: Chang'e-6 landed on the far side; Earth never above the horizon, hourly epochs 2023-2040
subChecks.measured: highest Earth elevation -32.790 deg at 2039-05-31 17:00 UTC across 157,777 epochs

gradeNote: Eclipse and Blue Ghost sunset run grade D (smooth sphere); Chandrayaan-3 runs grade C (LOLA 240 m skyline); the others are direction-only.
